contracts: (Candidate admission rejects a content identity that does not establish the real change under evaluation.) AND (The NFR-4 inspection rejects every shared mutable-state or evidence path that can create false success.) AND (The authored S24 selector proves that stale bound matrix evidence yields an invalid aggregate that cannot be accepted.) AND (The authored S7 selector rejects a Matrix Case whenever Stable and Candidate share fixture or execution state, and accepts only distinct subject bindings.) AND (The bidirectional reconciliation covers every repository caller, including VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing, and every applicable transition has its real-call receipt; omission fails.)

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.

selector_intents: Execute the authored S24 aggregation test with stale matrix evidence and observe the governance constraint check fail if the aggregate remains valid or acceptance-eligible.
Execute the authored S7 matrix test with Stable and Candidate bound to a shared fixture or execution-state identity, and observe the constraint check fail.
Run the candidate-content identity fault witness at Candidate admission.
Run the deterministic cross-component state-contamination witness against the isolation boundary check.
Run the omitted-applicable-transition witness through the reconciled Consumer route execution.
